name: neophp/framework
description: NeoPHP - an ultra modular PHP framework.

suggest.ext-fileinfo: Required to detect the mime type of uploaded files (File and Image constraints)
suggest.ext-pdo: Required to use the Database component
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required to connect to MySQL / MariaDB databases
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required to connect to PostgreSQL databases
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required to connect to SQLite databases
suggest.ext-zip: Required to archive log files as .zip
